thread:
incidents-bot: :warning: SLO alert: streaming API p99 tail latency >2.5s in eu-west2 for 7m. Error budget burn high. Paging oncall.
pagerduty-bot: Paging Dana H (oncall)  please acknowledge.
Dana H (oncall): acked. pulling console and tcp traces. marking incident. first glance: p99 ~3.0s, p95 ~600ms. initiating triage.
Lukas V: I can pair. Console shows spike correlating with network retransmit spikes from nat-gw-azb between 01:02-01:08 UTC. Also DNS lookup times jump for streaming workers.
Priya M: Support reporting 4 customers with intermittent streaming stalls, 2 dropped sessions. Ticket ids: 11011, 11012. Flagging customer-impacting.
Theo R: traces show increased TLS handshake RTT and lots of SYN retries. Many clients falling back to re-resolve DNS repeatedly. I see fragmented DNS responses (EDNS0) and some UDP truncation -> TCP fallback -> extra RTT.
Dana H (oncall): hypothesis: combined issue - NAT ephemeral exhaustion + intermittent UDP DNS truncation + host-level packet drops in azb causing SYN retries -> tail stalls. Quick mitigations: 1) expand ephemeral range on nat gateways 2) prefer local-az resolver endpoints for streaming workers 3) drain problematic instances behind nat-gw-azb 4) enable reduced handshake timeouts on proxies. Start with ephemeral range bump and resolver override.
Priya M: bumping ephemeral port range and conntrack tuning on nat-gw-azb/azc:
```
# increase ephemeral ports
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=\"15000 65535\"
# increase conntrack
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=200000
# drop long TIME_WAITs
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout=20
```
Lukas V: applied those on nat-gw-azb and nat-gw-azc. Observing connected sockets drop and fewer conntrack rejects.
tracing-bot: Traces collected: span sampling rate increased for streaming service for next 15m.
Theo R: changing DNS resolver for streaming fleet to force use of azd resolvers (azd has been healthy per console):
```
redwoodctl dns override --service streaming --region eu-west2 --resolvers resolver-azd-1,resolver-azd-2 --ttl 30
```
Theo R: override applied. streaming workers now point to azd resolvers. DNS latencies for streaming group dropped immediately to ~20ms.
Lukas V: draining instances behind nat-gw-azb from streaming pool to avoid bad egress path. new streams will land on nat-gw-aze/azd.
Dana H (oncall): executed drain:
```
redwoodctl pool drain --pool streaming-eu-west2 --node nat-gw-azb --grace 60
```
Lukas V: drain progressing. New session allocation shows shift to nat-gw-aze/azd.
Priya M: after changes, p99 dropped from ~3.0s -> ~1.5s over 6 minutes. p95 back within SLO. Retransmit counters decreased ~40%.
Theo R: still seeing a small number of long-tail stalls associated with very long-lived client connections; traces show slow KV cache warmup and occasional TLS renegotiation events increasing latency. Might be exacerbated by earlier retransmits.
Dana H (oncall): plan: keep nat-gw-azb drained for 45m, continue resolver override for 30m, keep conntrack/ephemeral changes, and collect pcaps for azb egress. Open provider ticket for potential host NIC/physical path issue.
incidents-bot: Runbook: open network provider escalation with pcap and timestamps.
Lukas V: capturing pcap on nat-gw-azb and a streaming proxy host for provider evidence:
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /var/tmp/azb-egress.pcap 'tcp or udp'
```
Lukas V: uploaded pcap to net-incident-512.
Priya M: Support updated customers with mitigation and ETA. Noted two sessions dropped; credits pending. Support will follow up with customers after RCA.
Theo R: provider ticket opened: CLOUD-78912. Attached pcap and conntrack dumps. Provider acknowledged possible hardware queueing on azb leaf switch; investigating.
Dana H (oncall): enabling temporary handshake keepalive tuning on streaming proxies to reduce expensive renegotiations:
```
# proxy tuning
export REDWOOD_STREAM_KEEPALIVE=30
systemctl reload redwood-proxy
```
Priya M: proxies reloaded. Tracing shows handshake count reduced and fewer renegotiations.
Lukas V: metrics stable for 12m. p99 ~1.4s, p95 ~500ms. We'll monitor for 30m before closing.
Dana H (oncall): assigning follow-ups for postmortem:
- Lukas V: correlate nat gateway load patterns + host NIC stats, provide timeline and recommendations.
- Theo R: summarize trace evidence showing DNS truncation -> TCP fallback impact and propose DNS redundancy per-az.
- Priya M: recommend permanent conntrack tuning and ephemeral range change; coordinate with infra for config roll-out.
Dana H (oncall): opening incident bridge for provider discussion and cross-team sync: https://meet.redwood/incident-2411111111
incidents-bot: Incident state: active -> mitigation in progress. Duration: 9m -> 48m so far.
Dana H (oncall): thanks team. I'll hand off to next oncall (Iris) if still open at +1h. Will compile notes and post final update when resolved.
